content: actions/download-artifact@v4+ supports cross-repo download via inputs github-token (needs actions:read on target), repository owner/name, run-id. Retention default 90 days. Simpler for composing two static sites: main-site workflow does actions/checkout with repository: patrickclery/dvd-seller + path:, builds it with NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH=/sale/dvds, copies out/ into main out/sale/dvds/. Trigger from dvd-seller via repository_dispatch (needs fine-grained PAT with contents:write/actions:write on main repo) or peaceiris/actions-gh-pages external_repository.
